product_metadata.title: Active Era Premium Twin Air Mattress with Built in Pump and Raised Pillow - Elevated Inflatable Mattress 75" x 39" x 18" - Puncture Resistant Blow Up Mattress Air Bed with Waterproof Flocked Top
features: COMFORTABLE & SUPPORTIVE: Raised 18 inches from the floor this air mattress twin is fitted with 21 structured air-coils which provide head to toe support for a relaxing and comfortable night’s sleep. This advanced support system prevents the dips and bulges which are common on other models of airbed, and allows for a weight capacity of up to 265 pounds.

BUILT-IN PILLOW: This blow up mattress with built in pump features a unique 3-inch built-in raised pillow for improved head and neck support and improved spinal alignment for bed-like comfort throughout the night.

FAST INFLATION: The integrated easy-to-use electric pump quickly inflates the twin size inflatable bed to full firmness in less than 3 minutes. At the flick of a switch it will automatically deflate the airbed for easy storage and transportation in the handy travel bag provided.

STRONG DURABLE DESIGN: Features an extra thick, hard wearing and warterproof flocked top layer which is both extremely durable and comfortable. This twin air mattress with built in pump has been engineered from 15-gauge puncture resistant material which resists accidental scrapes and scratches.
TWIN SIZE (SINGLE PERSON): This inflatable mattress has inflated dimensions of 39" x 75" x 18” (Pillow 21”). Puncture repair patches included.

REMEMBER! Stretching is a natural characteristic of new vinyl. During initial use, the airbed may become soft and require additional inflation to maintain desired firmness. This is normal for the first few days of use.
